A reference atlas for South Asian cancer histopathology

An open-access digital pathology atlas of whole-slide cancer images and clinical metadata from South Asia — built to close a stark gap in global reference imaging, and to train the diagnostic AI models the region's pathology services need.

    04 · About

    Why South Asia needs its own reference atlas

    South Asia accounts for nearly a quarter of the world's population but for less than one percent of the imaging data behind today's public pathology datasets and diagnostic AI models. That gap shows up as lower diagnostic accuracy for exactly the patients the models are meant to serve — different staining conventions, different case mix, different tissue handling from what the AI was trained on.

    This project page is Apex Bionet's public front door: a growing repository of standardized, pathologist-reviewed whole-slide images and clinical metadata, an interactive training module for the immunohistochemistry skills that make diagnoses reproducible, and a preview of the analytical models the reference set is training toward.
